note: Trust material is digest-bound BYTES. A trust-list name or URI is not an acceptable substitute: the bytes are an input to the finding, and the same asset yields a different trust finding under different material.

official_c2pa_trust_list.membership_status: NOT ESTABLISHED for any specimen in this bundle. No vendored specimen chains to this list. The list is committed so the anchors_supplied trust mode is exercisable and digest-bound, not because any specimen is a member.

supplied_allowed_list.claim_scope: trust-by-supplied-allowed-list. This proves the trust plumbing and that trust is a function of caller-supplied material. It is NOT evidence of membership on the official public C2PA trust list; those are different claims and only the former is evidenced here.
